name: Sreekala Sivasankaran

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sreekala Sivasankaran writes poetry and fiction in Malayalam and English and also works in translation. Based in Kottayam, Kerala, she brings a background in cultural scholarship to her literary practice; she formerly served as an Associate Professor at the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts in New Delhi. Her poetry collections include Samayathinte Manaltharikal, You Walk with Me, Dream of the Butterflies and Stranded.

“The Archive of Love” approaches memory as both a home and a picture held in a frame. Wounded leaves and flowers keep the marks of a storm, yet the poem moves towards a love without concealment. Its narrowing final lines slow the reading into an intimate affirmation of openness and constancy.
